name: The Okura Tokyo
positioning: Tokyo hotel in Toranomon, Minato-ku, set across two buildings with different styles: the traditional Japanese Heritage Wing and the 41-story Prestige Tower
best_for: Travelers who want traditional Japanese design, with a private steam sauna and jet bath in every Heritage room
Travelers who want high-floor Tokyo views from a modern tower

facts.text: The hotel is at 2-10-4 Toranomon, Minato-ku, Tokyo.
The hotel spans two buildings with different styles: the Prestige Tower and the Heritage Wing.
The Prestige Tower rises 41 stories and pairs the legacy of its grand lobby with ultra-modern design details.
Crafted Okura Lanterns create a light and shadow effect in the Prestige lobby.
The Heritage lobby has a mural honoring the Heian poetry scroll The Thirty-Six Immortals of Poetry.
Heritage Rooms have oak walls and traditional andon lanterns.
The Imperial Suite has a home theater, a workout room, and dry and steam saunas.
The Club Lounge is on the 37th floor.
Okura Fitness and Spa has a gym with skyline views, a pool and spa treatments.
Sazanka is a teppanyaki grill and viewing gallery on the 41st floor.
Yamazato restaurant offers private rooms for traditional Japanese cuisine.
Guests get free admission to the Okura Museum of Art.

highlights.text: The Heritage Wing lobby has wallpaper from the original Heian banquet room and a vast chandelier inspired by wisteria.
All Heritage rooms are junior suites or suites, each with a private steam sauna and jet bath.
From Prestige Corner rooms guests can pick out sights like the Imperial Palace and the three skyscrapers of Azabudai Hills.
The Imperial Suite has three bedrooms on the top two floors of the Prestige Tower.
Okura experiences include tours of the historic lobby, traditional tea ceremonies and the Okura Museum of Art.

considerations.text: The two buildings have different styles, traditional Japanese design in the Heritage Wing and ultra-modern design in the Prestige Tower, so it is worth choosing the building that suits you.
Okura Fitness and Spa has scheduled inspection and maintenance in 2027.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
